# Planview Viz - product overview (Avantra summary)

> Demonstration content summarised by Avantra from publicly available Planview positioning. Pending curator verification against the official product page and datasheet. Contains no pricing.

## Overview

Value stream management providing flow metrics on software delivery.

Also known as: Viz, Tasktop Viz. Solution areas: Value Stream Management, Digital Product Development. Deployment: SaaS.

## Capabilities

- **Value stream management** - a core capability of Planview Viz: Measure and improve software delivery flow (flow metrics).
- **Reporting & analytics** - a supported capability of Planview Viz: Dashboards and analytics across portfolios and work. Note: Flow-metric analytics.

## Implementation considerations

- Requires integration with delivery tools (typically via Planview Hub) to obtain flow data.
